title: Feature and ledger totals
goal: Each feature shows its total remaining and baseline days under the steps table; the ledger header shows the total remaining days of every open record
acceptance: The steps table gains a total row: remaining days, baseline days, and how many open steps have no number (`unknown n`), never counted as 0
The generated ledger top shows one line: open features, total remaining days, steps with unknown estimates
B- records without tasks count as their own record effort only when it carries a number; otherwise unknown
The totals are generated, never hand-edited, and check:work fails on a stale total
privacy: Metadata only: estimates, dates, durations and task identities; no prompts, transcripts or personal data.
validation: tools/test-tools.mjs fixtures: sums with quarter days, unknown steps, closed steps excluded from remaining, header line regenerated

effort.basis: renderLedger already owns the header segment and the steps table. Implemented 2026-11-11 in one branch with F-053–F-055; review and release remain. Estimate, not a measurement.

escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner (BACKLOG-RULES, "Optional upfront feature plans")
